strings.en: What now... Captain?
...Let's see. In any case, let's contact Commander Hazuki.
If Commander Hazard is right... that battleship, the Elshank, was it?
It'll be a threat.
And it was carrying robots, too. Plus... a small, strong one.
Yet those robots didn't attack us...
And Commander Hazard seems to be hiding something.
There's just too much we don't understand.
Gundam Fighters popping up, and I hear there's a mystery helper too?
That's right. He was pretty cool, though~.
Not that it matters, since we don't know who he is.
Sigh... I feel awful. We keep troubling the Gandor Team down there.
True... Anyway, Captain, let's try to contact them.
Right. The Mazinger team and Cyber Beast Force should be
on their way here, as planned.
...Zeon is getting more active too... Assuming they weren't shot down.
I'm worried about Kyosuke too. Wonder if he's doing okay?
At this rate... it's gonna be rough.
Lieutenant! Why the gloomy face?
Huh? Oh, was I making that face?
You're always just collecting Gundam data,
and you're kinda plain. So that's how you look.
(Plain... Nina's told me that too.)
Oh yeah, Nina at Anaheim said to say hi to you, Lieutenant.
What? Is she your girlfriend?
I-it's nothing like that. Nina's... just in charge of the Gundam project.
Uh-huh~
You two get along well. What are you talking about?
Oh, Umon. Doing maintenance on Grendizer?
Yes. Since the Mazinger team is coming,
I need to make space in the hangar while I'm at it.
Super robots coming to help is great news.
Yes. At the moment, the only unit that can be
everyone's shield on the front line is Grendizer.
For the battles ahead... we need their strength.
The HLV carrying the Mazinger team and Cyber Beast Force is missing!?
...Yes.
The Gaizok went that far...
How awful...!
It's because back then... we couldn't stop the Gaizok's descent...!
Lieutenant... What's done is done...
...You seem awfully calm... Commander Hazuki.
Fujiwara's lot won't just quietly get shot down... I believe that.
...Then the Gaizok...
The people who long foresaw the Gaizok's coming...
The Jin family's super robot, Zambot 3,
has gone after the Gaizok.
Zambot 3...? Never heard of it...
The Gandor Team currently has no robot capable of
chasing the HLV directly... All we can do is bet on them...
...Damn.
All we can do is... believe in them.
Captain, the enemy might pick it up, but...
shouldn't we broadcast our position regularly?
...You're right.
Commander, now it's my turn... I have bad news...
My, my, I'm truly impressed! To think you had technology like that...
Still... I'd like a little gratitude for us humble folk.
After all, the ones who found you and hooked up your energy supply line...
were us, you see.
...That is understood... So says Don.
Ah, splendid! I'm deeply moved, truly. To think...
to think that you had survived!
...State your wish... So says Don.
Oh, my, my... You see right through me, it seems...
Don't you speak that way precisely so we'll understand?
Well, hahahahahaha! You've got me there!
No, for now, I've only come to thank you for the teleport machine.
(I can't believe it was that easy to send that pest Ilbora to Earth.
Iga village or whatever, I don't care. I hope that young punk
goes and croaks down there... Guhuhu.)
Hazard Pasha...
Ah, yes, yes! What might it be?
Don appears quite weary... If your business is done,
we would like to end this here.
Oh my, my! Forgive me for being so inconsiderate!
Then I'll take my leave...
...You... a second chance has come... This time... this time for sure...
I see... So the Nadesico has gone...
Yes. It seems to have headed for Mars, just as we expected.
And those three Gundams that appeared
chasing a mysterious enemy... What are they planning?
They said they were under Major Ulube's orders...
Major Ulube... of Neo Japan?
Yes. They descended to Earth chasing that mysterious enemy,
so I couldn't learn more... Will the forces on the surface be all right?
We've had some unexpected reinforcements, so don't worry.
Could you mean that crane we heard about?
Yes. I plan to hear the details from them later,
but it seems they're not enemies.
In that case, the suspicions about Hazard at the base only grow deeper.
The Bunker pirates in space, the Dinosaur Empire back on Earth...
We already have more than enough trouble as it is...
For now, all we can do is fight defensively.
The Bunker and the Gyandlar seem to be harassing Zeon too,
so they're stuck on the defensive as well. That's some consolation.
I'll contact you later with more on the Elshank.
Whaaat!? Gil did!?
Dr. Tarsan... Then...
Yes... Gil's after Earth... or rather, Mia, it seems he's after you.
Mia, you're so popular.
Lamba, this ain't the time for that. What're you gonna do, Mia?
...I... I'm going to Earth...
Mia...
No! Just leave that backwater planet be!
Gil's aim is obvious! Don't fall for his bait!
Backwater or not doesn't matter! It's my... my home...
...Let's go, Mia. Let's go save your planet.
We can't be scared of the likes of Gil and the Bunker!
When I say no, I mean nooo!
The space pirates of the Bunker have their eye on you lot!
If you defy them any further...
Let's go, Mia. I can't just leave it alone.
Roll...
It's settled! Let's gooo!
Hey, wait, you lot! Hey!
Captain!
What is it, Lieutenant Emma?
We've picked up a distress signal from the HLV... the Mazinger team!
They're safe!
Wow! So the Cyber Beast Force is with them!
Right, we should move at once. ...Captain?
This is... a Gaizok ID signal...!?
Captain, what did you say!?
I hope this is good news... The Gaizok mothership has appeared near Earth.
It seems... it came up from Earth...
Which means... Oh! Right, that whatsit-3 robot too!?
Zambot 3.
And... a strange gravity field...? If it's nearby... or in our path,
we should probably investigate it, but...
One problem after another.
Maybe we should get an exorcism.
If that would settle it, I'd go as many times as it took.
Well then, Roux... take care.
Thanks for everything. I'll get this unit to Londo Bell, no matter what.
Something's... strange around the Moon.
Elle Vianno, who took Prototype Unit 4... I mean, the Gerbera Tetra
for us before... got surrounded by the enemy, I heard.
Isn't that just because Elle was dawdling?
...I hope that's all it is.
...I just feel like something's about to happen on the Moon.
With the Earth Sphere in such turmoil, it wouldn't be strange
if anything happened on the Moon.
If you don't stay positive, you'll age fast, Nina.
Oh, right, what about Judau? Can't he come along?
...The ZZ Gundam... Its energy transfer system is acting up.
That's that Gundam's lifeline, so it has to be checked properly.
It'll take a little more time...
...Roger. Well then... Roux Louka, launching!
Take care.
A distress signal!? From near the Moon!?
Huh, isn't that just like me? Maybe...
Its course... is from Anaheim.
Elle, it seems someone's in the same spot you were.
Getting surrounded by enemies in space is rough, y'know.
Oh my, spoken like someone who's been there.
Anaheim... Did Nina pull some strings again?
I'd be grateful if so... Captain, if it's an SOS, who's the enemy?
...It looks like the Vega Star Federation.
Near the Moon again...!?
Brother?
...I knew it... Something bugs me about this.
Brooding won't get us anywhere. ...Captain, I say we act.
Yes. But... we must decide on a route.
Joining the Mazinger team, the Gaizok signal... and the Moon, huh.
